Lock Washer

Lock Washer

A washer fitted between a lock nut and an adapter sleeve to keep the nut from loosening. There is a bent-tab type, where the inner tang is fitted into the shaft groove and the outer tab is then bent into a nut groove, and a non-bent type, which is used as is.
